name: kitchen-late

description.en: The console's kitchen board (/admin/, tab Kitchen) colours each ticket by the venue's own notify.order.late_min: amber (kds-age-warn) at half of it, red (kds-age-late) at it -- the same rule as the canvas board (room/canvas/feed.js ages()). The board reads GET /api/owner/settings?location_id once per 5 minutes; unset, 0, 1 or a non-number keeps 10/20. The owner sets the value in the Wire pane (admin/tax.js), POST /api/owner/settings.
description.uk: Кухонна дошка в консолі фарбує квиток за налаштуванням закладу notify.order.late_min: жовтий на половині, червоний на ньому; без значення лишається 10/20.

producer.what: settings(): GET /api/owner/settings -- the owner gets every value; staff at the pass get KITCHEN_READS only (access.rs:286 settings_for_kitchen), which carries notify.order.late_min

consumer.what: readLate(): reads the settings once per 5 min and redraws on a change; render() line 103 passes them to kitchen-logic.js:124 thresholds(venue, settings), whose rule is lateMin() (line 116)

writer.what: set_setting(): POST /api/owner/settings {key, value}, the owner's own write (admin/tax.js Wire pane)

auth.how: the owner's token: it reads and writes the setting and signs the console (sessionStorage dw_at, localStorage dw_loc)

probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-kitchen-late.mjs: owner reads late_min, sets it to 8, places a TEST order, opens /admin/ Kitchen with the owner token, moves the page clock ~5 min: the TEST ticket is kds-age-warn (10/20 would be ok) and the page read /api/owner/settings; finally restores late_min and ends the order.
